question: During which of the following years did Qutb ud-Din Aibak rule?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1206 – 1210**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Qutub-ud-din Aibak was the founder of the Slave dynasty.
 
• He assumed the title of '**Sultan**' for the first time in the history of India.
 
• He made Lahore the capital and** later Delhi.**
 
• He was also known as '**Lakh Baksh**' or giver of lakhs for his magnanimity, as he gave a lot of liberal donations.
 
• He started the **construction of the Qutub Minar in the memory of Khawaja Qutubuddin Bhaktiyar Kaki** but could complete only the first story.
 
• Aibak is **known for having commissioned the Qutb Minar **in Delhi, and the Adhai Din Ka Jhopra in Ajmer.
 
• Note:
 
 
• Qutub-ud-din Aibak laid the foundation of Qutub Minar which was later completed by Iltutmish.
 
• The Quwwat-al-Islam mosque was also commissioned by him.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Tughlaq Dynasty:
 
 
• ​The founder of the **Tughlaq dynasty was Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq.**
 
• The Tughlaq dynasty was founded in 1320 by Ghazi Malik assuming the title of Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq.
 
• He founded Tughlaqabad City and constructed the Tughlaqabad Fort.
 
• He made reforms in the field of the judiciary, irrigation, and agriculture.
 
• He died in 1325 by collapsing a building during a celebration of his victory.
 
 
 
• **Khilji Dynasty:**
 
 
• It was the second ruling family of the **Delhi Sultanate, a Muslim kingdom in north India.**
 
• The Khilji dynasty ruled from 1290 to 1320.
 
• It was founded by Jalal ud din Firuz Khilji and came to power in a revolution that signified the transfer of authority from Turkic nobility to Afghans.
 
• Alauddin Khilji made serious efforts to re-assess the land revenue and unify the taxes not only in rural areas but also in urban areas.
 
• He established a **centralized administrative system of revenue collection.**
 
• Muqtis were appointed for revenue collection.
 
• Alauddin made sure that their offices were not hereditary.
 
• He kept proper control over them.
 
 
 
• The Lodi dynasty:
 
 
• Founder - Bahlol Lodi (1451-88 AD)
 
• Last king - Ibrahim Lodi (1517-26 AD)
 
• The city of Agra was founded by Sikandar Lodi (1489-1517)
 
• Daulat Khan Lodi was the governor of Punjab who invited the Babur.
